skills.description: Generates approximately 48-second English speaking short video scripts for Douyin voiceover recording. This is an English casual-chat account featuring daily ramblings, personal thoughts, and life observations with an authentic, down-to-earth tone. Scripts sound like natural self-talk or journaling rather than formal speech. Output includes Chinese-English bilingual script, IPA phonetic transcription, pronunciation tips, and vocabulary translation with usage notes. Use when user provides a topic keyword and requests an English oral practice video script, or mentions keywords like English script, oral practice script, English short video, Douyin English voiceover, or daily English ramblings.

skills.description: Amazon广告搜索词报告否定短语关键词分析。从搜索词报告中提取多词搜索词的相邻2词组合， 在完整数据集中评估每个词组的转化效果，筛选出低转化率、低ROAS但高点击的词组作为否定短语候选。 当用户提到[词组否定][可以词组否定的词][告诉我需要词组否定的词][否定短语][phrase negative] 及相近语义时触发。需要用户提供搜索词报告Excel路径和广告活动名称。
skills.description_zh: 从亚马逊【商品推广_搜索词_报告】中找出需要添加到词组否定的关键词。需要提供<报告文件路径>，<广告活动名称>，<输出文件路径>。
skills.name: amazon-negative-search-term-phrase
